svg.title: Push-Based Shuffle -- ShuffleBlockPusher & ESS Merge
svg.desc: ESS RemoteBlockPushResolver config, post-status-update ShuffleBlockPusher, FinalizeShuffleMerge, and push-merged-local + fallback reads. 1. YarnSchedBackend to DAGScheduler: getShufflePushMergerLocs (driver-1 in-JVM); 2. Shuffle Writer to Push-Based Shuffle: postStatusUpdate -> push (worker-a in-JVM); 3. Push-Based Shuffle to ESS Merger B: PushBlockStream(s=4, p=0) (worker-b:7337); 4. DAGScheduler to ESS Merger B: FinalizeShuffleMerge(s=4) (worker-b:7337); 5. DAGScheduler to MapOutputMaster: registerMergeResults(s=4) (driver-1 in-JVM); 6. Shuffle Reader to MapOutputMaster: GetMapAndMergeResultStatuses (driver-1:41000); 7. Shuffle Reader to ESS Merger B: GetLocalDirs(merger miss) (worker-b:7337); 8. Shuffle Reader to Shuffle Reader: Read merged meta & chunks (worker-b local-disk); 9. Shuffle Reader to Ext Shuffle Service: Fallback unmerged (map 2) (worker-a:7337)
